about: Woolacombe Surf Centre is in Barton Court in the centre of Woolacombe. It teaches beginner to advanced surfers aged from 8 to over 80, and offers tailored private sessions for younger children. It also runs kayaking, coasteering and eFoil sessions and hires out surf, SUP and kayak kit.
where: Shop 5, Barton Court, Barton Road, Woolacombe EX34 7BA
goodToKnow: Equipment and in-water action photos included
Changing and storage facilities on site
gaps: Season, cancellation terms and what to bring were not stated.
